name: Schema Standardization and Migration
description: Migrate all existing schemas to JSON Schema 2020-12 with standardized conventions: camelCase properties, PascalCase definitions, kebab-case filenames, and mandatory metadata ($schema, $id, title, description). Extract reusable definitions to shared defs.json.
purpose: Establish a consistent schema surface across the entire project. Every schema speaks the same language with the same conventions.
acceptanceCriteria: All schema files use kebab-case naming
Every schema has $schema, $id, title, and description metadata
Tribunus.dev domain used instead of opencode.ai or rig.relay
